brief:
Jean Said Makdisi's reissued memoir "Beirut Fragments" recounts scenes of bombardment, siege, and civilian resistance during Israel's military operations in Lebanon, according to Middle East Eye. The work draws parallels to current devastation in Gaza, presenting accounts of wartime horror and its impact on civilians.

Makdisi's narrative captures experiences of bombardment and siege through personal testimony and civilian accounts of resistance during the conflict.
dek: 'Beirut Fragments' captures the horror Israel keeps inflicting on Lebanon Submitted by Belen Fernandez on Tue, 10/13/2026 - 07:16 Jean Said Makdisi's reissued memoir recounts bombardment, siege and civilian resistance in scenes painfully familiar from Gaza…
title: Reissued memoir documents Israeli bombardment of Lebanon and civilian resistance
